session_summary: chan.arcs.care (Prophet/Chan Suh discovery-call artifact) built end-to-end across ~20 commits: Player/Coach/Pacecar frame, instrument-panel principles + architecture-loop SVG, conductor-lane build telemetry, 16-slide SEEN/HEARD/VIBE-CHECK presentation mode (Maya Lin moiré topography, isometric floor, fathom rail, chrome auto-hide), full ARCS-OS design-system conformance pass (Inter/JetBrains Mono, 8-step type scale, canonical tokens via DesignSync), FOCUS-default progressive disclosure with per-section TL;DRs. Forked to status.arcs.care (Prophet/presentation content stripped) for standalone build-status use. PII (email/phone) removed from both footers; robots noindex confirmed on both. Two real mobile bugs found from live device photos and fixed: echo-mid rotate(90deg) connector overflowing its grid row (root cause: CSS transforms repaint in place but don't change layout footprint), and the architecture SVG diagram cutting off with no scroll affordance on phone widths. Presentation chrome (top/bottom bars) also fixed to stop drifting slide-to-slide (flex space-between → CSS grid 1fr/auto/1fr), and the isometric floor's fixed-px perspective (560px) was breaking on ultrawide/zoom — changed to 70vh so it scales with viewport. Last commit c536792, deployed and verified live on both domains.
